title: An unknown member at the top level or in `params` is ignored
notes: Members a receiver does not know are dropped rather than refused, which is what makes a later minor able to add one: `capabilities` carries a name the server does not know, `params` carries a nested object it has never heard of, and the hello is seated normally. The asymmetry with methods is deliberate: an unknown *method* is answered `unknown_method` and never silently dropped.
